name: Example - Cross-Asset Class Trend Following
hypothesis: Assets in a positive long-term trend persist across asset classes (equity, bonds, gold, commodities, international equity and crypto), reflecting slow-moving capital and herding that unwinds slowly.
_note: Demonstrates a MULTI-ASSET COMBINATION: one signal applied across six different classes. Cross-class replication of an edge is the strongest evidence the lab can produce.
